sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and the rights rule
sections.what: Brings in the rights check, the retrieval function and the document type. The header states the rule.
sections.watch_out: This file and the retrieval function both check rights, so keeping them aligned matters.

sections.name: embeddable
sections.title: Keeps documents allowed to be embedded
sections.what: Returns only documents whose source allows embedding. Used before indexing.
sections.why: The header says embedding must be allowed.
sections.watch_out: It checks only the list it is given, so documents added later are not checked until they pass through here.

sections.name: retrieveForSnapshot
sections.title: Searches documents up to a cutoff
sections.what: Searches the documents for a query, excluding anything observed after the cutoff and anything whose source cannot be embedded, and returns the top results (five by default).
sections.why: The comment says a snapshot must not include later observations.
sections.watch_out: The default of five applies unless callers pass a number, and a larger number changes what generated text can cite.

summary: Guards document search so only documents from sources that allow embedding are indexed or returned, and nothing observed after the cutoff.
purpose: Keeps retrieval, which finds supporting documents for generated text, within the rights and time limits.
why: The header says only documents whose source allows embedding may be indexed or returned.
how: 1. A filter helper keeps documents whose source allows embedding. 2. Snapshot retrieval passes the query, the documents, the cutoff and the rights check to the retrieval function, and returns up to five results by default.
inputs: Query text, a list of documents, a cutoff time and an optional result count.
risks: The filter helper and the snapshot function both check rights, so they must stay in step. The retrieval function itself is not in this file.
debug: If no documents come back, check the source's embed rights and the documents' observed times against the cutoff.
